findings.description: The KMS key does not enable key rotation (enable_key_rotation is absent, which defaults to false). Long-lived customer master keys with no rotation increase the blast radius if key material is ever compromised and violate the practice of periodic re-keying for data-at-rest encryption keys.

No aws_kms_key_policy is attached to the key. When no key policy is supplied, only the default policy granting the account root full KMS access applies, so there are no explicit, least-privilege restrictions on which principals may encrypt, decrypt, or administer this key. Any principal with broad kms:* IAM permissions in the account can use or re-target the key, weakening access control over the audit-trail data encryption key.
